title: Generation of highly pure motor neurons from human induced pluripotent stem cells
protocol: Thaw Matrigel Matrix at 4°C.
Make smaller aliquots using refrigerated pipette tips.
Dilute Matrigel in DMEM-F12 (1:1) to prevent gelling during long term storage.
Add 100 μL of Matrigel to 10 mL of cold DMEM-F12 media for dilution.
Add 1 ml diluted Matrigel matrix to each well of the 6-well plate.
Incubate the plate at 37°C for a minimum of 1 hour.
Aspirate Matrigel just before seeding cells.
Rapidly thaw a hiPSC cryovial by gently swirling in a 37°C water bath until almost no ice remains.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of pre-warmed iPSC culture medium mTesR1 with 10 μM ROCK inhibitor.
Spin cells at 200 × g for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in mTesR1 medium containing 10 μM ROCK inhibitor.
Transfer 2 mL of the cell suspension into each well of a Matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Start the first cell passage when cells reach about 70% confluency.
Prepare another Matrigel-coated 6-well plate for iPSC induction.
Remove medium from wells.
Wash wells once with DPBS.
Add 1 mL Versene to each well and incubate at 37°C for 6-7 minutes.
Aspirate Versene from the wells.
Add 2 mL mTesR1 medium to the wells.
Gently pipette up and down to dislodge cells.
Triturate 2-3 times with a 5 mL pipette to break colonies into smaller pieces.
Collect medium containing cell colonies in a 15 mL tube.
Add extra mTesR1 medium to reach a total volume of 12 mL.
Gently mix cell suspension by pipetting up and down 2 or 3 times.
Transfer 2 mL cell suspension to each well of the newly Matrigel-coated 6-well plate.
Place 6-well plate in incubator.
Change iPSC culture medium daily.
Aspirate hiPSCs culture medium from the 6-well plate.
Add 2 mL of iPSC induction medium containing 10 μM RA and 0.5 mM VPA to each well.
Replace the medium completely with fresh medium for seven days.
Prepare resuspension growth medium/KOSR medium with 10 μM Rock inhibitor.
Warm up resuspension growth medium/KOSR medium at room temperature.
Remove iPSC induction medium and wash wells once with DPBS.
Add 1 mL Versene to each well and incubate at 37°C for 6–7 min.
Remove Versene and add 1 mL of KOSR medium (resuspension medium) to each well.
Gently shake the plates to dissociate cells.
Scrape cells by using a 5 mL pipette if necessary.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube.
Triturate the cell suspension 1–2 times using a pipette to break apart larger cell clusters into smaller aggregates.
Add 1 mL KOSR medium to rinse the well and pool together with the cell suspension in the 15 mL tube.
For 3 wells of a 6-well plate, add approximately 9 mL of KOSR medium to a low attachment Petri dish and transfer the total cell suspension volume (∼6 mL) to the Petri dish.
Gently mix the cell suspension with KOSR medium in the Petri dish.
Check under microscope that most cells are in aggregates.
Let aggregates fully suspend, ensuring the total volume is approximately 15 mL in each Petri dish.
Change resuspension growth medium/KOSR medium every 2 days and culture cell aggregates for 4 days to form embryoid body (EB).
Gently swirl the plate and transfer cell suspension into a 15 mL conical tube.
Allow the cell aggregates to settle to the bottom of the tube for about 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant, leaving approximately 1 mL.
Add approximately 14 mL of fresh KOSR medium.
Carefully transfer cell suspension to an Ultra-low attachment Petri dish.
Gently shake the petri dish to aid uniform distribution of the aggregates.
Place the petri dish back into the incubator.
Transfer cell suspension (embryoid body at 4 days) to a 15 mL tube.
Let aggregates settle down to the bottom of the tube for about 10 minutes.
Remove supernatant, leaving approximately 1 mL.
Add approximately 14 mL of NSP medium.
Carefully transfer cell suspension to an Ultra-low attachment Petri dish.
Replace with fresh NSP medium every two days.
Cells are cultured in NSP medium for 7 days to form neurospheres.
Remove supernatant, leaving approximately 1 mL liquid.
Add 5 mL of DPBS to wash the aggregates.
Incubate aggregates at room temperature for approximately 10 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and add 8 mL Accutase to NSP aggregates.
Incubate at 37°C for 15 minutes.
Gently pipette 5 strokes with a 5 mL pipette in the middle at around 7 minutes.
Add approximately 3 mL of NPC medium to neutralize the digestion.
Gently pipette up and down several times to break most aggregates into singular cells.
Spin cells at 200×g for 3 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellet in appropriate volume of NPC medium.
Seed NPCs onto Matrigel-coated 10 cm culture plates.
When NPCs reach approximately 90% confluency, prepare for frozen stocks.
Remove small aggregates (white spots) by filter pipette tip.
Gently shake the medium and remove the supernatant.
Wash once with DPBS.
Add 3 mL Accutase to each 10 cm plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 2–3 minutes.
Gently shake the plate; most cells should be dissociated from the plate.
Add 3 mL NPC medium with rock inhibitor to neutralize the digestion.
Pipette gently to dissociate cells from the plate.
Transfer cell suspension to a 15 mL tube.
Spin down at 200×g for 3 min.
Take an aliquot (∼20 μL) from cell suspension for cell counting by a hemocytometer (optional).
Remove supernatant and resuspend cell pellets into desired volume of precold (4°C) NPC freeing medium.
Aliquot quickly into cryovials.
Transfer cryovials into a freezing container.
Place the freezing container in a −80°C freezer overnight.
Transfer cryovials to a cryogenic storage container with liquid nitrogen for long-term storage on the next day.
Quickly thaw a frozen stock of HEK293T cells in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer the cells to a 15 mL tube with 5 mL DMEM medium and centrifuge at 200×g for 3 min.
Discard the supernatant and re-suspend the cells in 10 mL fresh HEK Cell Culture medium.
Seed HEK293T cells into a 10 cm tissue culture plate.
Grow cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 in a standard tissue culture incubator.
Split cells for expansion once they reach about 90% confluency.
Aspirate media from culture plate and wash once with 1× PBS.
Incubate cells with 0.5 mL of 0.05% Trypsin (0.25% Trypsin diluted with 1× PBS) for 2–4 min until cells have been fully detached.
Add 3 mL of HEK cell culture medium to inactivate the dissociation reagent.
Triturate the cells to create single cell suspension, collect the cells into a 15 mL tube and centrifuge the cells at 200×g for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet into proper volume of HEK culture medium.
Split cells in 10 cm plates at the ratio of 1:3 to 1:5.
Seed about 8 × 10^6 HEK293T cells into each 10 cm culture plate for lentivirus production.
Add the lentiviral plasmid and the packaging vectors to DMEM (no serum) as described in the recipe below.
Mix well by pipetting up and down for a few times.
Add desired amount of PEI into plasmid mixture.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down for 10 times.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature (∼25°C) for 15 min.
Add the mixture (1 mL/10 cm plate) dropwise to each plate with gentle rocking.
Gently mix by shaking up and down, and then left and right for a few times.
Put the plate back into incubator.
Gently replace medium with 10 mL HEK cell culture medium for each plate after overnight (∼16 h) incubation.
Collect viral supernatants at about 48 h post-transfection (first collection).
Add back 10 mL fresh HEK cell culture medium for each plate and incubate.
Store the viral supernatant at 4°C.
Collect viral supernatants at about 72 h post-transfection (second collection).
Discard the plates in a biohazard bag and trash it after autoclave.
Pool two collections of the same lentivirus together.
Filter the viral supernatants with 0.45 μm vacuum filters.
Store lentivirus at 4°C till use (within two weeks).
Freeze lentivirus at −80°C for longer term storage.
Seed HEK cells in a 24 well plate at a density of 8 × 10^4 cells/well/0.5 mL medium.
Make a serial dilution (e.g., 1:10, 1:100) of viral supernatant with HEK culture medium.
Add 50 μL of undiluted and diluted lentivirus to desired wells.
Set one well as a negative control without transduction.
Change the medium after 8 h or overnight (∼16 h) exposure to lentivirus.
Check the percentage of positive cells after 48–72 h.
Rapidly thaw NPC frozen cryovials by gently swirling the vial in a 37°C water bath until there is just a small bit of ice left in the vial.
Transfer cells to a 15 ml conical tube containing 5 ml of pre-warmed NPC culture medium in a laminar flow cabinet.
Spin down cells at 200×g for 3 min.
Gently resuspend cell pellets into the proper volume of NPC medium.
Seed NPCs onto Matrigel-coated plates at a density of 3 × 104 cells/cm2.
Add about 300 μL lentiviral supernatant to each well for transduction.
Replace the culture medium with Neuronal Maturation Medium after exposure to lentivirus.
Half change the medium every other day until analysis or replating.
Prepare coverslips with a monolayer of astrocyte cells.
Isolate mouse astrocytes from postnatal day 1 (P1) pups.
Culture isolated mouse astrocytes in DMEM with 15% FBS.
Rapidly thaw frozen astrocytes in a 37°C water bath.
Transfer cells to a 15 mL conical tube containing 5 mL of pre-warmed astrocyte culture medium in a laminar flow cabinet.
Centrifuge the cells at 200×g for 3 min.
Add 10 mL of astrocyte culture medium and gently resuspend cell pellet.
Seed astrocytes onto Matrigel-coated plates at a density of 3 × 10^4 cells/cm^2.
Prepare Matrigel-coated 24-well plate with glass coverslips.
Once astrocyte cells reach about 90% confluency, aspirate media from astrocyte cell culture plate.
Wash once with 1× PBS.
Incubate cells with 3 mL of 0.05% Trypsin in PBS for 2–4 min until cells have been fully detached.
Add 3 mL of astrocyte cell culture medium to inactivate the dissociation reagent.
Collect the cells into a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 200×g for 3 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells in 12 mL of astrocyte cell culture medium.
Triturate the cells to create single-cell suspension.
Seed onto Matrigel-coated coverslips (0.5 mL/well).
Aspirate media from the MNs culture plate at 5 dpi.
Wash once with 1× PBS.
Dissociate MNs from culture plates.
Incubate cells with 1 mL of dissociation reagent for 2–4 minutes until most cells are detached.
Add 2 mL of DMEM:F12 medium to neutralize the dissociation reagent.
Collect the cells into a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 200×g for 3 minutes.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend cells gently in an appropriate volume of neuronal maturation medium.
Seed at a density of 1 × 10^3 cells/cm^2 dissociated MNs onto coverslips with astrocytes (0.5 mL/well).
Change half volume of Neuronal Maturation Medium every other day until analysis.
Examine MN identity by immunostaining specific markers at different developmental stages.
Verify neuronal morphology under inverted microscopy in living cultures within 7 days post-infection.
At 14 days post-infection, fix coverslips and immunostain with neuron-specific markers such as TUBB3, MAP2, and SMI-32.
Take coverslips from 24-well plates at desired time points (7 dpi, 14 dpi, etc.).
Fix cultured cells with 4% paraformaldehyde in PBS (pH 7.4) and incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Wash twice with PBS.
Incubate fixed cells in blocking buffer (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA) for 1 h for permeabilization and blocking.
Incubate fixed cells with primary antibodies in blocking buffer (PBS containing 0.2% Triton X-100 and 3% BSA) at 4°C overnight (∼16 h).
Remove primary antibodies from fixed cells.
Wash coverslips with PBS for 10 min × 3.
Incubate fixed cells with corresponding fluorophore-conjugated secondary antibodies in dark, at room temperature for 2 h.
Wash coverslips with PBS for 10 min × 3.
Incubate cells with Hoechst 33342 (1 μg/mL in PBS) for 10 min to stain cell nuclei.
Briefly wash coverslips with PBS twice.
Mount coverslips with mounting medium on microslides.
Air dry the coverslips at room temperature in dark (30 min to a few hours).
Visualize cells under the confocal microscope.
